After the maximum retries configured via ECUC_TcpIp_00069 are transmitted, the timer according to TcpIpTcpRetransmissionTimeout shall be restarted the last time before the TCP connection is clo sed.

After the maximum retries configured via ECUC_TcpIp_00069 are transmitted, the timer according to  either TCPIP_PARAMID_TCP_RETRANSMIT_TIMEOUT if provided by TcpIp_ChangeParameter( ) or  TcpIpTcpRetransmissionTimeout if TCPIP_PARAMID_TCP_RETR ANSMIT_TIMEOUT was not provided by TcpIp_ChangeParameter() shall be restarted the last time before the TCP con nection is closed.
